newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Solid Group up 7.84 pct on rebound.
newsitem.headline: Solid Group up 7.84 pct on rebound.

text.p: Consumer electronics manufacturer Solid Group Inc's shares rose in midsession on Friday by 40 centavos, or 7.84 percent, to 5.50 pesos on a technical rebound, brokers said.
"It has been one of the oversold issues. When the market took a dive, Solid went with it. We are seeing a technical rebound," said Fritz Aclan, research head at Dharmala Securities (Phils) Inc.
Teresa Lee, Lippo Securities assistant vice-president, said the issue could further rise on the company's sound fundamentals.
Solid is the Philippine's sole franchisee of Sony Corp and Aiwa Co Ltd products.
By midsession on Friday, 11.17 million Solid shares had changed hands.
